answer: Every claim climbs the whisper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the oasis re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The raven of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
